category_title: Low-achieving students who are ignored or disengage during group activities
scenario_title: Mixed-ability group work on multiple-choice assessment
minimal_context: The student is working in a mixed-ability group on a multiple-choice test to ensure all members understand the lessons.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work with your group on this multiple-choice test. The goal is to make sure that every member understood the lessons.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The better students went faster and they did not always clearly explain information to me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Have you tried asking them for additional explanations?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I won't risk asking for additional explanations. I feel uncomfortable when I express my ideas because they just 'jumped into my mouth' when I get stuck.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You should still try to contribute to the group's answers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do they always have to recheck my work? I feel devalued when other members revise what I’ve done. The group decisions are mostly made by only one or two members, so I'm put into a jobless situation where I have nothing to do but listen passively or fall to sleep.

task.content: working on an assessment as a multiple-choice test
task.learning_goal: make sure that every member understood the lessons

context.environment: mixed-ability groups that consisted of a balance of five low- to five high-achievers
context.materials: multiple-choice tests, group project, detailed and comprehensive powerpoint presentation

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: higher-achieving students usually ‘jumped into their mouth ’(i.e., demeaned them) when they got stuck
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: listen passively to others or ‘fall to sleep ’
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: felt uncomfortable when they expressed their ideas to others
